data.body:
Remediation implemented on the local host (2026-09-06 ~13:08 PDT), targeting both legs of the RCA (footprint × retention):

1. FOOTPRINT — Copilot Serena repointed to the mirror. ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json (backup kept alongside) now launches Serena with --project /Users/joeoakhart/.rebar-serena-mirror, matching Claude's existing config and AGENTS.md's documented design (Serena reads a read-only mirror of origin/main). Expected per-session drop: ~1.34GB → ~130MB. Takes effect for new Copilot sessions; live 1.3GB servers were left alone (owned by active sessions).

2. FOOTPRINT (defense-in-depth) — ~/rebar/.serena/project.yml (gitignored, host-local) now sets explicit ignored_paths: .tickets-tracker/**, .tickets-hotpath-authoritative/**, .worktrees/**, .rebar/**, .venv/** — covers any remaining full-checkout Serena use (currently Codex).

3. RETENTION — mem-sentinel (com.joeoakhart.mem-sentinel, 5-min launchd interval) extended with an orphaned-harness sweep: logs every PPID-1 copilot/uvx/serena-chain process (ORPHAN lines with age+RSS), and reaps (SIGTERM, logged as REAPED) PPID-1 copilot older than 24h and PPID-1 uv/serena older than 1h. Rationale: interactive harnesses always have a terminal parent; the incident leaker was a 5.3-day launchd-parented copilot holding MCP pipe fds, and this ticket's experiments proved uv/Serena exit within ~3s of parent death. Sweep logic unit-tested against fabricated ps output (day-form etime, sub-threshold orphans, non-orphans) — all 6 cases correct; live run clean.

REMAINING (needs Gerrit): ~/rebar/.codex/config.toml is a TRACKED file and launches Serena with --project-from-cwd (= full checkout). Repointing it to the mirror (or shipping the ignored_paths in a tracked serena project template) is a repo change requiring claim + refs/for/main review — left as follow-up under this ticket. Upstream fix candidates also remain: Copilot CLI child-process/process-group teardown on exit (vendor issue), which the reaper only mitigates.
